items.title: How much do trust and channel count actually change adoption speed?
items.description: Dana's real rollout used all four channels (code, writing, review, relationships) with a full year of built-up trust behind her, and it took 6 weeks for all three teams to adopt. This model holds that 6-week outcome as the baseline and lets you drag two of L2's variables — how much trust the proposer already has, and how many of the four channels they actually use — to see how adoption time stretches as either one drops.

params.name: trust
params.label: Built-up trust/credibility (0 = brand new to the org, 100 = Dana's actual level)

params.name: channels
params.label: Channels actually used (1 = writing only, 4 = code + writing + review + relationships)

items.compute: const raw = 6 * (80 / params.trust) * (4 / params.channels); const weeks = Math.min(52, Math.round(raw * 10) / 10); return { weeksToAdopt: weeks };
